note: Game stages. In each turn the first option is right; the others are [text, kind g (grammar) | w (word), grammar lesson id or "", why in Persian, why in English]. Every right answer and every line passes the grammar checker.

turns.s: Hi! I'm Emma. Are you a new student?
turns.sf: سلام! من اِما هستم. تو دانش‌آموز جدیدی؟
o: Yes, I am. Nice to meet you.
Yes, I'm. Nice to meet you.
g
be
در جواب کوتاه، شکل کوتاه I'm را آخر جمله نمی‌گذاریم؛ درستش Yes, I am است.
A short answer can't end with the short form I'm. Say: Yes, I am.
Yes, I are. Nice to meet you.
g
be
بعد از I فعل am می‌آید، نه are.
After I we use am, not are.
Yes, I am. Nice to meat you.
w
meat یعنی «گوشت». «خوشبختم» می‌شود Nice to meet you و meet یعنی «آشنا شدن».
Meat is food. The phrase is Nice to meet you.

turns.s: Where are you from?
turns.sf: اهل کجایی؟
o: I'm from Iran. I live in Tehran.
I'm from Iran. I lives in Tehran.
g
present-simple
‎-s فقط برای he/she/it است. با I می‌گوییم I live.
The -s ending is only for he/she/it. Say: I live.
I from Iran. I live in Tehran.
g
be
فعل am جا افتاده. «من اهل ایرانم» می‌شود I'm from Iran.
The verb am is missing: I'm from Iran.
I'm from Iran. I live on Tehran.
w
prep-place
برای شهر و کشور in می‌گوییم: in Tehran. ‏on برای سطح و خیابان است.
Use in with cities and countries: in Tehran.

turns.s: Do you like our school?
turns.sf: مدرسه‌مان را دوست داری؟
o: Yes, I do. It's very nice.
Yes, I like. It's very nice.
g
present-simple-nq
like بدون مفعول تنها نمی‌آید. جواب کوتاه Do you…? می‌شود Yes, I do.
Like needs an object. The short answer to Do you…? is Yes, I do.
Yes, I does. It's very nice.
g
present-simple-nq
does برای he/she/it است. با I می‌گوییم Yes, I do.
Does is for he/she/it. With I say: Yes, I do.
Yes, I do. It's very tired.
w
adjectives
tired یعنی «خسته» و برای آدم است. مدرسه می‌تواند nice یا beautiful باشد.
Tired is for people. A school can be nice or beautiful.

turns.s: Good morning! What would you like?
turns.sf: صبح بخیر! چی میل دارید؟
o: I'd like a cup of coffee, please.
I like a cup of coffee, please.
g
verb-patterns
برای سفارش دادن I'd like می‌گوییم که کوتاه‌شده‌ی I would like است. ‏I like یعنی «در کل دوست دارم».
To order, say I'd like (I would like). I like means you like it in general.
I'd like an coffee, please.
g
articles
an فقط قبل از صدای صدادار می‌آید، مثل an apple. قبل از coffee می‌گوییم a coffee یا a cup of coffee.
An is only used before a vowel sound. Say a coffee or a cup of coffee.
I'd like a plate of coffee, please.
w
plate یعنی «بشقاب». قهوه را در فنجان می‌خوریم: a cup of coffee.
A plate is for food. Coffee comes in a cup.

turns.s: Would you like some cake with it?
turns.sf: کیک هم کنارش میل دارید؟
o: No, thanks. I'm not hungry.
No, thanks. I don't hungry.
g
be
hungry صفت است و با فعل be می‌آید: I'm not hungry. ‏don't برای فعل‌های معمولی است.
Hungry is an adjective, so it takes be: I'm not hungry.
No, thanks. I'm not hunger.
g
adjectives
hunger اسم است («گرسنگی»). صفتش hungry است: I'm not hungry.
Hunger is a noun. The adjective is hungry.
No, please. I'm not hungry.
w
برای رد کردن مؤدبانه No, thanks می‌گوییم. ‏please برای خواستن است.
To say no politely, say No, thanks. Please is for asking.

turns.s: That's four dollars fifty.
turns.sf: می‌شود چهار دلار و پنجاه سنت.
o: Here you are. Can I pay by card?
Here you are. Can I to pay by card?
g
can
بعد از can فعل ساده بدون to می‌آید: Can I pay…?
After can, use the verb without to: Can I pay…?
Here you are. Do I can pay by card?
g
can
can خودش سؤال می‌سازد و do نمی‌خواهد: Can I pay…?
Can makes its own question, without do: Can I pay…?
Here you are. Can I pay by cart?
w
cart یعنی «چرخ خرید». کارت بانکی card است.
A cart is a shopping trolley. You pay by card.

turns.s: Hello. Can I help you? You look lost.
turns.sf: سلام. کمک می‌خواهید؟ به نظر گم شده‌اید.
o: Yes, please. Where is the museum?
Yes, please. Where the museum is?
g
questions
در سؤال، فعل قبل از فاعل می‌آید: Where is the museum?
In a question the verb comes before the subject: Where is the museum?
Yes, please. Where are the museum?
g
be
museum مفرد است، پس is می‌گیرد: Where is the museum?
Museum is singular, so it takes is.
Yes, please. When is the museum?
w
questions
when یعنی «کِی». برای جا where («کجا») می‌پرسیم.
When asks about time. To ask about a place, use where.

turns.s: Go straight and turn left at the bank. It's next to a big park.
turns.sf: مستقیم بروید و کنار بانک به چپ بپیچید. کنار یک پارک بزرگ است.
o: Is it far from here?
Does it far from here?
g
questions
far صفت است و فعل جمله be است، پس سؤالش Is it far…? می‌شود نه Does.
Far is an adjective, so the question uses be: Is it far…?
Is it far of here?
w
prep-place
می‌گوییم far from («دور از»)، نه far of.
We say far from, not far of.
Is it long from here?
w
برای فاصله far می‌گوییم. ‏long برای طول چیزها یا زمان است.
For distance say far. Long is for length or time.

turns.s: No, it isn't. You can walk there in five minutes.
turns.sf: نه، دور نیست. پنج دقیقه‌ای پیاده می‌رسید.
o: Great! Thank you very much for your help.
Great! Thank you very much for you help.
g
pronouns
قبل از اسم صفت ملکی your می‌آید، نه you: for your help.
Before a noun use your, not you: for your help.
Great! Thanks you very much for your help.
g
یا Thank you می‌گوییم یا Thanks؛ Thanks you غلط است.
Say Thank you or Thanks, never Thanks you.
Great! Thank you very much for your health.
w
health یعنی «سلامتی». «کمک» می‌شود help.
Health means being well. The word you need is help.

turns.s: Hello. What's the problem?
turns.sf: سلام. مشکل چیست؟
o: I have a bad headache and I feel tired.
I have a bad headache and I am feel tired.
g
present-simple
دو فعل am و feel با هم نمی‌آیند. یا I feel tired یا I am tired.
Don't put am and feel together. Say I feel tired or I am tired.
I have a bad headache and I feel tiring.
g
adjectives
حال خود آدم با ‎-ed است: tired («خسته»). ‏tiring یعنی «خسته‌کننده».
Your own feeling is -ed: tired. Tiring means it makes you tired.
I have a strong headache and I feel tired.
w
برای سردرد شدید bad یا terrible می‌گوییم، نه strong.
For pain we say a bad or terrible headache, not strong.

turns.s: When did it start?
turns.sf: از کِی شروع شد؟
o: It started two days ago.
It starts two days ago.
g
past-simple
ago یعنی گذشته، پس فعل گذشته می‌خواهد: It started.
Ago shows the past, so the verb must be past: started.
It was start two days ago.
g
past-simple
گذشته‌ی start می‌شود started و was لازم ندارد.
The past of start is started, without was.
It started before two days.
w
past-simple
«دو روز پیش» در انگلیسی two days ago است؛ before two days نمی‌گوییم.
In English it is two days ago, not before two days.

turns.s: Did you take any medicine?
turns.sf: دارویی خوردید؟
o: No, I didn't. I just drank some tea.
No, I didn't. I just drinked some tea.
g
past-simple
drink بی‌قاعده است: گذشته‌اش drank است.
Drink is irregular. Its past is drank.
No, I didn't took any. I just drank some tea.
g
past-nq
بعد از didn't فعل ساده می‌آید: I didn't take any.
After didn't use the base verb: didn't take.
No, I didn't. I just ate some tea.
w
در فارسی «چای خوردم» می‌گوییم، ولی در انگلیسی نوشیدنی را drink می‌کنیم: drank some tea.
In English you drink tea, you don't eat it.

stages.te: A job interview at a bookshop
stages.ee: 🎉 Well done! You got the job!

turns.s: Thanks for coming. How long have you lived in this city?
turns.sf: ممنون که آمدید. چند وقت است در این شهر زندگی می‌کنید؟
o: I've lived here for two years.
I live here for two years.
g
since-for
کاری که از گذشته شروع شده و هنوز ادامه دارد حال کامل می‌خواهد: I've lived here for two years.
For something that started in the past and still goes on, use the present perfect: I've lived…
I've lived here since two years.
g
since-for
برای مدت زمان for می‌آید. ‏since برای نقطه‌ی شروع است، مثل since 2024.
Use for with a length of time. Since is for a starting point.
I've lived here during two years.
w
since-for
during یعنی «در طولِ» یک رویداد، مثل during the summer. برای مدت کار ادامه‌دار for می‌گوییم.
During goes with an event. For a length of time use for.

turns.s: Have you ever worked in a shop before?
turns.sf: تا حالا در مغازه کار کرده‌اید؟
o: Yes, I have. I worked in a café last summer.
Yes, I have. I have worked in a café last summer.
g
present-perfect
last summer زمان تمام‌شده‌ی گذشته است و با آن گذشته‌ی ساده می‌آید: I worked.
With a finished time like last summer, use the past simple: I worked.
Yes, I have. I work in a café last summer.
g
past-simple
last summer گذشته است، پس فعل هم گذشته می‌شود: I worked.
Last summer is in the past, so the verb must be past: I worked.
Yes, I have. I worked in a café next summer.
w
next summer یعنی «تابستان آینده» و با گذشته جور نیست. درستش last summer است.
Next summer is in the future. For the past say last summer.

turns.s: Why do you want this job?
turns.sf: چرا این کار را می‌خواهید؟
o: Because I love books and I enjoy helping customers.
Because I love books and I enjoy to help customers.
g
gerund-infinitive
بعد از enjoy فعل ‎-ing می‌آید: enjoy helping.
After enjoy use the -ing form: enjoy helping.
Because I love books and I am enjoy helping customers.
g
present-simple
am و enjoy با هم نمی‌آیند: I enjoy helping.
Don't put am and enjoy together: I enjoy helping.
Because I love books and I enjoy helping costumers.
w
costumer یعنی «لباس‌دوز تئاتر». «مشتری» customer است.
A costumer makes costumes. A person who buys is a customer.

turns.s: Welcome to your first day! Do you have any questions before we start?
turns.sf: به روز اول کارت خوش آمدی! قبل از شروع سؤالی داری؟
o: Yes. What should I do if I make a mistake with the money?
Yes. What should I do if I do a mistake with the money?
w
collocations
«اشتباه کردن» در انگلیسی make a mistake است، نه do a mistake.
In English you make a mistake, not do a mistake.
Yes. What should I do if I will make a mistake with the money?
g
first-conditional
بعد از if برای آینده حال ساده می‌آید، نه will: if I make a mistake.
After if, use the present for the future, not will: if I make a mistake.
Yes. What should I do if I make a fault with the money?
w
collocations
fault یعنی «تقصیر» یا «عیب». برای «اشتباه کردن» می‌گوییم make a mistake.
Fault means blame or a defect. For an error, say make a mistake.

turns.s: Don't worry, just tell me. Now, please pay attention to the prices on the books.
turns.sf: نگران نباش، فقط به من بگو. حالا لطفاً به قیمت‌های روی کتاب‌ها توجه کن.
o: OK. I'll pay attention and check every price.
OK. I'll make attention and check every price.
w
collocations
«توجه کردن» در انگلیسی pay attention است.
In English you pay attention.
OK. I'll pay attention and check all price.
g
quantifiers
بعد از all اسم جمع می‌آید، مثل all the prices؛ یا بگو every price.
Use a plural after all, as in all the prices, or say every price.
OK. I'll pay attention and control every price.
w
control یعنی «مهار کردن» یا «در دست داشتن». برای «وارسی کردن» می‌گوییم check.
Control means to have power over something. To look at something carefully is check.

turns.s: You've worked hard all morning. Why don't you take a break?
turns.sf: همه‌ی صبح سخت کار کردی. چرا کمی استراحت نمی‌کنی؟
o: Thanks! I'll take a short break and have lunch.
Thanks! I'll make a short break and have lunch.
w
collocations
«استراحت کوتاه کردن» در انگلیسی take a break است.
In English you take a break.
Thanks! I'll taking a short break and have lunch.
g
will
بعد از will شکل ساده‌ی فعل می‌آید: I'll take.
After will use the base verb: I'll take.
Thanks! I'll take a short brake and have lunch.
w
brake یعنی «ترمز». «استراحت» break است.
A brake stops a car. A rest is a break.

turns.s: Hi! Are you free this weekend? Let's go somewhere.
turns.sf: سلام! این آخر هفته وقتت آزاد است؟ بیا یک جایی برویم.
o: Great idea! Let's go on a trip to the mountains.
Great idea! Let's go to a trip to the mountains.
w
collocations
«سفر رفتن» در انگلیسی go on a trip است، نه go to a trip.
In English you go on a trip, not go to a trip.
Great idea! Let's going on a trip to the mountains.
g
imperatives
بعد از Let's شکل ساده‌ی فعل می‌آید: Let's go.
After Let's use the base verb: Let's go.
Great idea! Let's go on a travel to the mountains.
w
collocations
travel بیشتر فعل است یا «مسافرت» به طور کلی. برای یک سفر مشخص می‌گوییم a trip.
Travel is mostly a verb or travel in general. For one journey, say a trip.

turns.s: Should we drive? There's always heavy traffic on Fridays.
turns.sf: با ماشین برویم؟ جمعه‌ها همیشه ترافیک سنگینی است.
o: Let's go by train. It's faster and cheaper.
Let's go with train. It's faster and cheaper.
w
collocations
برای وسیله‌ی نقلیه by می‌آید: by train، by bus، by car.
For transport use by: by train, by bus, by car.
Let's go by the train. It's faster and cheaper.
g
collocations
بعد از by برای وسیله‌ی نقلیه a یا the نمی‌آید: by train.
After by, don't use a or the with transport: by train.
Let's go by train. It's more faster and cheaper.
g
comparatives
faster خودش صفت برتر است و more لازم ندارد.
Faster is already a comparative, so don't add more.

turns.s: Perfect! Don't forget your camera. The view is beautiful.
turns.sf: عالی! دوربینت یادت نرود. منظره خیلی قشنگ است.
o: Don't worry. I'll take lots of photos.
Don't worry. I'll make lots of photos.
w
collocations
«عکس گرفتن» در انگلیسی take a photo است.
In English you take a photo.
Don't worry. I'll take lots of photo.
g
plurals
بعد از lots of اسم شمارش‌پذیر جمع می‌آید: lots of photos.
After lots of, a countable noun is plural: lots of photos.
Don't worry. I'll catch lots of photos.
w
collocations
catch برای گرفتن توپ یا رسیدن به اتوبوس است. برای عکس می‌گوییم take.
Catch is for a ball or a bus. For photos, say take.

stages.e: 🎉 آفرین! هفته‌های اولت در شهر تازه عالی گذشت.
stages.ee: 🎉 Well done! Your first weeks in the new city went great.

turns.s: Hi, I'm Sam, Emma's brother. Thanks for coming to my birthday party!
turns.sf: سلام، من سام هستم، برادر اِما. ممنون که به جشن تولدم آمدی!
o: Happy birthday, Sam! This present is for you.
Nice birthday, Sam! This present is for you.
w
collocations
برای تبریک تولد می‌گوییم Happy birthday.
To wish someone well on their birthday, say Happy birthday.
Happy birthday, Sam! These present is for you.
g
this-that
present مفرد است، پس this می‌آید، نه these.
Present is singular, so use this, not these.
Happy birthday, Sam! This present is to you.
w
برای «مال تو» یا «برای تو» for می‌آید: This present is for you.
To say who gets something, use for: This present is for you.

turns.s: The music is really loud, isn't it? Can you hear me?
turns.sf: صدای موسیقی خیلی بلند است، نه؟ صدایم را می‌شنوی؟
o: Yes, I can. But maybe you should turn the music down a little.
Yes, I can. But maybe you should close the music a little.
w
collocations
صدای موسیقی را turn down می‌کنیم، یعنی «کم می‌کنیم». close برای در و پنجره است.
You turn music down. Close is for doors and windows.
Yes, I can. But maybe you should to turn the music down a little.
g
modals
بعد از should شکل ساده‌ی فعل بدون to می‌آید: should turn.
After should use the base verb without to: should turn.
Yes, I can. But maybe you should turn the music down a few.
g
quantifiers
a few با اسم شمارش‌پذیر می‌آید. برای «کمی» در این جمله a little می‌گوییم.
A few goes with countable nouns. Here, to mean a bit, say a little.

turns.s: Sure. Hey, would you like some cake? My mother made it.
turns.sf: حتماً. راستی، کیک می‌خواهی؟ مادرم پخته.
o: Yes, please! I'm having a great time at your party.
Yes, please! I'm passing a great time at your party.
w
collocations
«خوش گذشتن» در انگلیسی have a great time است.
In English you have a great time.
Yes, please! I have a great time at your party.
g
simple-continuous
برای چیزی که همین الان در جریان است حال استمراری می‌آید: I'm having a great time.
For something happening right now, use the present continuous: I'm having a great time.
Yes, please! I'm having a great time in your party.
w
prep-place
برای مهمانی at می‌آید: at your party.
With a party, use at: at your party.
